data.name: Gurjant
data.gender_notes: Gurjant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Gurjant is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘guru’ meaning teacher or guide and ‘jant’ meaning sword. This name is symbolic of a spiritual warrior who is guided by their guru and uses their wisdom and courage to protect and serve. The name Gurjant carries the meaning “Lord of the Guru's Sword” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gurjant usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the guru's sword and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the power of spiritual guidance and the courage to act on it.
data.etymology: Gurjant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Guru's Sword.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gurjant total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
